name: RWKU
description: A benchmark for evaluating real-world knowledge unlearning in large language models, focusing on the practical setting where neither forget nor retain corpora are accessible, using 200 real-world famous people as unlearning targets and a comprehensive evaluation framework including membership inference and adversarial attack probes.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark from the unlearning literature that is cited for addressing the realistic setting where retain/forget data are unavailable.
notes: Focuses on unlearning knowledge about 200 famous people; evaluates with multiple attack and utility metrics.
